Bug_Details:
This code creates a database connect using a hardcoded, constant password. Anyone with access to either the source code or the compiled code can
    easily learn the password.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates a common security issue where a database password is hardcoded as a constant in the source code. This makes it easily accessible to anyone who can view the source or compiled code.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by attempting to establish a database connection using the showBug method, which contains the hardcoded password. The trigger occurs when the connection is established using this hardcoded password.
